q: 1. To cope up high temperature of 196°C, the taxi ways and aprons are constructed with ...........
explain: High temperatures from jet blasts require heat-resistant materials; concrete and specialized tar mixtures are used for durability.

q: 2. Pick up the correct statement from the following ...........
options: tar concrete pavements are suitable if fuel spillage occurs
rubberised tar concrete hot blast as well as spillage
epoxy asphalt concrete resists the jet fuels and provides more elastic pavement
explain: Specialized pavement mixtures are required in aprons and taxiways to prevent damage from fuel leaks and high-temperature engine exhaust.

q: 3. The depressions and undulations in the pavement, are caused due to ...........
explain: Pavement failure is usually a combination of poor subgrade preparation and the repetitive high-stress cycles of aircraft loading.

q: 4. Pick up the incorrect statement from the following ...........
options: channelization of pavement is caused by constant use of tri-cycle gears of aircraft
blast pads are used over cohesionless soils to resist erosion due to tremendous speed of the jet blast
over-run areas of at least 300 m length on either side of the runway are provided
explain: All listed statements (a, b, and c) are technically correct practices in airport engineering, so 'none of these' is the incorrect statement.

q: 5. To cope up high temperature of 196°C, the taxi-ways and aprons are constructed with
explain: Rubberized tar concrete is used for its resistance to high heat and fuel spillage from aircraft.

q: 6. Pick up the correct statement from the following
options: tar concrete pavements are suitable if fuel spillage occurs
rubberised tar concrete hot blast as well as spillage
epoxy asphalt concrete resists the jet fuel and provides more elastic pavement
epoxy asphalt concrete sets in very small time
explain: This covers the specialized material requirements for different areas of airport pavement.

q: 7. The depressions and undulations in the pavement, are caused due to
explain: All listed factors contribute to the deformation and wear of airport pavement surfaces.

q: 8. Pick up the incorrect statement from the following
options: channelization of pavement is caused by constant use of tri-cycle gears of aircraft
blast pads are used over cohesion less soils to resist erosion due to tremendous speed of the jet blast
over-run areas of at least 300 m length on either side of the runway are provided
explain: The statements (a), (b), and (c) are all standard practices; therefore, none is incorrect.

q: 9. *Strength of runway pavement is expressed as
explain: California Bearing Ratio (CBR) is the standard empirical test used to estimate the load-bearing capacity of pavement subgrades.

q: 10. Which of the following is an example of failure in flexible pavements?
explain: Alligator cracking (fatigue cracking) is a classic structural failure in asphalt/flexible pavements. Mud pumping and warping are typical of rigid pavements.

q: 11. What is the function of aircraft drainage?
options: to lower the sub-surface water level
to intercept & divert the surface and ground water flow
explain: Drainage systems handle surface runoff and sub-surface water to protect the pavement structure.
